sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Song Magic: Destruction Beat
spells.note: Her offensive spell; mode 0 of the Song book is this effect (a bolt of sound) under its own name.

spells.name: Song Magic: Rhythm Cushion
spells.note: Her defensive spell: a cushion of air. The existing Aria Armour page is this effect under its own name.

spells.name: Song Magic: Heal Lullaby
spells.note: NEW page. The song that healed Asta's wounds and restored his stamina.

spells.name: Song Magic: Mother Lullaby
spells.note: NEW page. A lullaby that puts a target to sleep; a defensive spell can block it.

spells.name: Crescendo
spells.note: LEGACY page locked to Kahono since 1.44.0 (not on the wiki's list): kept in her set so it stays reachable.

planned.name: Union Magic: Sea God Slash
planned.note: With Kiato: her song boosts his sword dance. It is Kiato's page in the Butoh book; a Song-book copy was not built.

planned.name: Union Magic: Sea God's Descent
planned.note: With Kiato, anime only; Kiato's page.

notes: Her old singing system (song.SongSkill: hymn, lullaby, barrier, requiem) is a separate skill and is untouched. Not in her grimoire (kept in the basic Song book): Staccato-style cuts, the Choir field and domain, Choir of Spirits, Metronome, Harmony and Grand Finale are this mod's own pages.
